# Asteroid

> Asteroid is a premium website design agency in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. We design and build custom, bilingual (English/Arabic) and 3D/WebGL websites for businesses across the UAE and GCC.

- Website: https://asteroid.design
- Arabic site: https://asteroid.design/ar
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +971 55 283 0119 · hi@asteroid.design
- Hours: Sunday–Friday, 9am–8pm (GST)
- Location: Dubai, UAE (serving Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and all emirates, plus the GCC)

## Services
- Website design in Dubai and across the UAE
- 3D website design (WebGL, Three.js, motion)
- Arabic & English bilingual websites with right-to-left layouts
- SEO-ready development (performance, structured data, Search Console, Google Business Profile)
- E-commerce and custom web features
- Website care plans (updates, security, backups, yearly growth review)

## Pricing (AED, fixed price agreed in writing)
- Launch — from AED 10,000: up to 5 custom-designed pages, ~3 weeks
- Growth — from AED 25,000: up to 12 pages, English + Arabic, bookings/forms, editing dashboard, ~5–6 weeks
- Signature — AED 50,000+: 3D & interactive experiences, online store, custom integrations
